scripts.setup: npm --prefix frontend install && cd backend && uv sync
scripts.dev:api: cd backend && uv run --env-file ../.env python manage.py migrate && uv run --env-file ../.env python manage.py runserver 127.0.0.1:8000
scripts.dev:worker: cd backend && uv run --env-file ../.env celery -A config worker --pool=solo --loglevel=info
scripts.dev:beat: cd backend && uv run --env-file ../.env celery -A config beat --loglevel=info --schedule=.celerybeat-schedule
scripts.test: cd backend && uv run --env-file ../.env pytest && cd ../frontend && npm test
scripts.seed: cd backend && uv run --env-file ../.env python manage.py seed_demo
scripts.messages: docker compose run --rm --no-deps -u root backend sh -c "apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq gettext && python manage.py makemessages -l ur -l ar --ignore=.venv --ignore=tests --no-obsolete --no-location && python manage.py compilemessages --ignore=.venv"
